author: devin-ai (Cognition)
name: Int6 MLP3x + SmearGate + EMA + XSA + Partial RoPE
blurb: 11L 512d MLP3x GQA8/4. Int6 per-row quant + zstd-22. SmearGate, EMA decay=0.997, XSA on last 4 layers, Partial RoPE 16 dims, Muon+AdamW (LR=0.03, WD=0.035, mom=0.99), BigramHash(4096,128), sliding window eval stride=64, U-Net skips. seq_len=2048, batch=524K, warmdown=5000.
